# HBO Max
> Stream series, movies, originals, family programming, and live sports with HBO Max.

HBO Max is Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming service for on-demand entertainment and live sports. The site centers on account access and subscription signup, with support resources hosted on the HBO Max Help Center and brand assets available through the HBO Max brand portal.

## Main Site
- [HBO Max Home](https://www.hbomax.com/): Main landing page for streaming series, movies, originals, family titles, and live sports.
- [Sign In](https://auth.hbomax.com/login?flow=login): Account login page for existing HBO Max subscribers.
- [Sign Up](https://auth.hbomax.com/product): Subscription purchase flow for new HBO Max customers.

## Account & Subscription
- [Login](https://auth.hbomax.com/login?flow=login): Sign in to manage your HBO Max account and start streaming.
- [Choose a Plan](https://auth.hbomax.com/product): Start a subscription and select an available HBO Max plan.
- [Subscription Plans Comparison](https://help.hbomax.com/us/Answer/Detail/000002547): Compare HBO Max plans, features, and supported streaming options.
- [Manage Your Subscription](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Help center entry point for billing, plans, and account management topics.

## Help Center
- [HBO Max Help Center (US)](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Official support hub for account, billing, device, and playback help.
- [HBO Max Help Center (Spanish)](https://help.hbomax.com/us-es): Spanish-language support center for HBO Max customers in the US.
- [HBO Max Help Center (Turkey)](https://help.hbomax.com/tr-tr/): Turkish-language support center for account, billing, and streaming assistance.

## Streaming & Playback Support
- [Troubleshooting and Technical Help](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Support resources for playback issues, app problems, and streaming errors.
- [Device and App Support](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Help articles covering supported devices, app access, and setup guidance.
- [Watching HBO Max](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Browse help topics related to streaming content and using the service.

## Billing & Account Help
- [Billing Help](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Support resources for charges, payments, renewals, and subscription billing questions.
- [Sign-In Help](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Assistance for login issues, password resets, and account access problems.
- [Account Management Help](https://help.hbomax.com/us): Guidance for updating account details and managing subscription settings.

## Plans & Service Information
- [Plan Comparison](https://help.hbomax.com/us/Answer/Detail/000002547): Overview of available plans and included streaming features.
- [HBO Max Home](https://www.hbomax.com/): Consumer-facing overview of the streaming service and featured entertainment.
- [Sign Up Now](https://auth.hbomax.com/product): Direct path to begin a new HBO Max subscription.

## Brand Resources
- [HBO Max Brand Portal](https://brand.hbomax.com/): Official brand guidelines and marketing assets for HBO Max.
- [Brand Home](https://brand.hbomax.com/): Access visual identity resources and partner-facing brand materials.
